name: GEVME
description_en:
Gevme is an event-management family covering registration, websites, onsite check-in, mobile engagement, virtual experiences and business matching. It distinguishes Gevme Registration from Gevme Omnichannel, with hardware options for onsite delivery. A free website/virtual-venue workspace is therefore not equivalent to free paid-event registration and physical badge operations.

The right configuration depends on which touchpoints need to connect and where attendee data moves. Pricing has separate software and onsite areas, with annual Starter/Pro subscriptions and custom enterprise terms. The retrieved page mixes SGD plan cards and USD FAQ prices; these are reported as separate currency displays, not converted into one normalized quote.
description_zh:
Gevme 产品家族涵盖报名、网站、现场签到、移动互动、线上体验及商务配对，区分 Registration 与 Omnichannel，并提供现场硬件。因此，免费网站/线上场地工作区不等于付费活动报名与实体徽章流程免费。

配置取决于哪些触点需要连接以及数据如何流动。定价分软件与现场部分，Starter/Pro 年付，企业定制。本次页面同时展示 SGD 卡片与 USD FAQ，本文分别保留，不转换成统一报价。

core_features.explanation_en: Forms, attendee lists, emails, payments and reports belong to the Registration offer.
core_features.explanation_zh: 表单、名单、邮件、支付与报表属于 Registration 方案。

core_features.explanation_en: Manage sites, virtual venues, app content and higher-tier matching/streaming.
core_features.explanation_zh: 管理网站、线上场地、应用内容及较高层级的配对/直播。

en: Connect a conference order to attendee content access and a physical badge.
zh: 把会议订单关联到参与者内容访问及实体徽章。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Choose the product areas, quote currency and hardware, then test one order-to-access-to-check-in handoff.
steps.zh: 选择产品区、报价币种及硬件，再测试订单到访问及签到的交接。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Separate annual Registration/Omnichannel licenses and onsite equipment/services; extra-attendee metering.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Omnichannel cards: SGD 1,500/year Starter, SGD 3,400/year Pro. FAQ: USD $1,050/$2,400 yearly for Starter/Pro in Omnichannel and Registration. Enterprise custom; Free limited Omnichannel editing/content. Additional attendees from USD $2.10; base capacity, organizer users, equipment and other costs require confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Omnichannel 卡片为 Starter SGD 1,500/年、Pro SGD 3,400/年；FAQ 为 Omnichannel 与 Registration 的 Starter/Pro 美元 $1,050/$2,400 年费。企业定制，免费限全渠道编辑/内容。额外人数起 USD $2.10，基础容量、管理用户、设备及其他费用需确认。

sources.title: Omnichannel Event Management Software | Gevme
sources.research_notes_en: Omnichannel event family covers websites, registration, onsite hardware, apps and matching; AI outcome claims are vendor-described.

sources.title: Flexible Virtual Event Platform Pricing Plans | Gevme
sources.research_notes_en: Separate Omnichannel/Registration/Onsite offers; SGD cards and USD FAQ have different currencies, annual plans and extra attendee charges; no automatic conversion.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Select Registration, Omnichannel and onsite independently
sections.title_zh: 分别选择报名、全渠道与现场配置
sections.en: Registration handles forms, ticket/order data and communication; Omnichannel handles event websites, content, apps and virtual engagement. They can work together, but are separate pricing areas. For an illustrative conference, follow one attendee from an order into private content and then a badge. Check buyer versus attendee identity, access level and the resulting report rather than assuming a shared brand makes every data handoff automatic.
sections.zh: Registration 处理表单、票单及沟通，Omnichannel 处理网站、内容、应用及线上互动。两者可以配合，但价格分区不同。例如会议应沿一名参与者核对订单、私有内容和徽章，检查购买者与到场人身份、访问等级及报表，不能因同品牌就假定交接自动正确。

sections.title_zh: 保留币种与产品上下文
sections.en: Omnichannel cards show Starter from SGD 1,500/year and Pro SGD 3,400/year. The FAQ states USD $1,050 and $2,400 yearly for both Omnichannel and Registration Starter/Pro. These are different currency presentations; no exchange rate or checkout amount was verified. Omnichannel Free includes website/virtual-venue editing, content and themes, while private pages, app and other capabilities depend on tier.
sections.zh: Omnichannel 卡片列 Starter 年费起 SGD 1,500、Pro SGD 3,400；FAQ 列 Omnichannel 和 Registration 的 Starter/Pro 年费美元 $1,050/$2,400。这是不同币种展示，未核实汇率或结账金额。Omnichannel Free 包含网站/线上场地编辑、内容及主题，私有页面、应用等依套餐变化。

sections.title_en: Budget hardware and attendee overages separately
sections.title_zh: 单独预算硬件与人数超额
sections.en: The onsite area lists standing and tabletop kiosks and laptop/printer/scanner counter sets. Those require a hardware booking and event-day setup, not just a software account. The FAQ lists extra Starter/Pro attendees from USD $2.10 each, without establishing the base allowance in this extracted view. Confirm organizer users, payment fees, custom domains, integration work and support with the selected product quote.
sections.zh: 现场区列立式、桌面终端及电脑/打印机/扫描仪柜台组合，需要硬件预订和活动日配置，不只是软件账户。FAQ 列 Starter/Pro 增加人数起每人 USD $2.10，但本次视图未确定基础人数。应结合所选产品报价确认管理用户、支付费、域名、集成和支持。

sections.title_en: Validate the connected experience and its recovery
sections.en: Gevme merits investigation for multi-touchpoint events needing registration, content and onsite services. A simple public page may fit the bounded Free area, but paid registration, streaming and equipment need their own entitlement checks. Pilot one changed registration and an onsite exception, then export the result. No installation, payment, kiosk, virtual stream or AI output was tested. No source license or self-hosted package was established; contractual location, retention and recovery remain gaps.
sections.zh: 多触点活动需要报名、内容及现场服务时可研究 Gevme。简单公开页面可核查有限免费区，但付费报名、直播和设备需单独确认权益。建议测试报名修改与现场异常后再导出结果。本文未测试安装、支付、终端、线上直播或 AI 输出，未确认源码许可或自托管服务包，合同位置、保留和恢复仍有缺口。

research_gaps: No registration, data sync, payment, private-page access, kiosk, stream, AI analysis or export was tested.
Exact capacity, selected currency/quote, hardware/processor fees, integration mapping, contract data terms, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
